versos.grego: Πιστὸς ὁ λόγος· εἴ τις ἐπισκοπῆς ὀρέγεται, καλοῦ ἔργου ἐπιθυμεῖ.

controles.web: This is a faithful saying: if a man seeks the office of an overseer, he desires a good work.
controles.kjv: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.
controles.livre: Esta palavra é fiel: se alguém deseja ser bispo, deseja uma excelente obra.

versos.grego: δεῖ οὖν τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ἀνεπίλημπτον εἶναι, μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἄνδρα, νηφάλιον, σώφρονα, κόσμιον, φιλόξενον, διδακτικόν,

controles.web: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;
controles.kjv: A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;
controles.livre: É dever, portanto, que o bispo seja irrepreensível, marido de uma mulher, sóbrio, comedido, decente, hospitaleiro, apto para ensinar;

versos.grego: μὴ πάροινον, μὴ πλήκτην, ἀλλὰ ἐπιεικῆ, ἄμαχον, ἀφιλάργυρον,

controles.web: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
controles.kjv: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
controles.livre: Não dado ao vinho, não violento,  mas sim moderado, não briguento, não cobiçoso por dinheiro;

versos.grego: τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου καλῶς προϊστάμενον, τέκνα ἔχοντα ἐν ὑποταγῇ μετὰ πάσης σεμνότητος,

controles.web: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
controles.kjv: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
controles.livre: que governe bem a sua própria casa, e tenha os seus filhos em submissão com toda dignidade.

versos.grego: (εἰ δέ τις τοῦ ἰδίου οἴκου προστῆναι οὐκ οἶδεν, πῶς ἐκκλησίας Θεοῦ ἐπιμελήσεται;)

controles.web: (but if a man doesn’t know how to rule his own house, how will he take care of the assembly of God?)
controles.kjv: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)
controles.livre: (Pois, se alguém não sabe governar a sua própria casa, como cuidará da igreja de Deus?)

versos.grego: μὴ νεόφυτον, ἵνα μὴ τυφωθεὶς εἰς κρίμα ἐμπέσῃ τοῦ διαβόλου.

controles.web: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.
controles.kjv: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.
controles.livre: Não um novo convertido; para que não se torne arrogante, e caia na condenação do diabo.

versos.grego: δεῖ δὲ καὶ μαρτυρίαν καλὴν ἔχειν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔξωθεν, ἵνα μὴ εἰς ὀνειδισμὸν ἐμπέσῃ καὶ παγίδα τοῦ διαβόλου.

controles.web: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.
controles.kjv: Moreover he must have a good report of them which are without; lest he fall into reproach and the snare of the devil.
controles.livre: É dever também que tenha bom testemunho dos que estão de fora, para que não caia em reprovação pública e na cilada do diabo.

versos.grego: Διακόνους ὡσαύτως σεμνούς, μὴ διλόγους, μὴ οἴνῳ πολλῷ προσέχοντας, μὴ αἰσχροκερδεῖς,

controles.web: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money;
controles.kjv: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
controles.livre: De maneira semelhante, os diáconos  sejam de boa conduta, não contraditórios, não dados a muito vinho, não cobiçosos de ganho desonesto,

versos.grego: ἔχοντας τὸ μυστήριον τῆς πίστεως ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει.

controles.web: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
controles.kjv: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
controles.livre: mas mantenham o mistério da fé em consciência pura.

versos.grego: καὶ οὗτοι δὲ δοκιμαζέσθωσαν πρῶτον, εἶτα διακονείτωσαν ἀνέγκλητοι ὄντες.

controles.web: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
controles.kjv: And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.
controles.livre: E também esses sejam primeiro testados, depois sirvam, se forem irrepreensíveis.

versos.grego: γυναῖκας ὡσαύτως σεμνάς, μὴ διαβόλους, νηφαλίους, πιστὰς ἐν πᾶσιν.

controles.web: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.
controles.kjv: Even so must their wives be grave, not slanderers, sober, faithful in all things.
controles.livre: De semelhante maneira, as mulheres sejam de boa conduta, não maldizentes, sóbrias, e fiéis em todas as coisas.

versos.grego: διάκονοι ἔστωσαν μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἄνδρες, τέκνων καλῶς προϊστάμενοι καὶ τῶν ἰδίων οἴκων.

controles.web: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
controles.kjv: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
controles.livre: Os diáconos sejam maridos de uma mulher, e governem bem os filhos e as suas próprias casas.

versos.grego: οἱ γὰρ καλῶς διακονήσαντες βαθμὸν ἑαυτοῖς καλὸν περιποιοῦνται καὶ πολλὴν παρρησίαν ἐν πίστει τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.

controles.web: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: For they that have used the office of a deacon well purchase to themselves a good degree, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
controles.livre: Pois os que servirem bem obtêm para si uma posição honrosa e muita confiança na fé que há em Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: Ταῦτά σοι γράφω ἐλπίζων ἐλθεῖν πρὸς σὲ τάχειον·

controles.web: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly;
controles.kjv: These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:
controles.livre: Escrevo-te essas coisas esperando ir a ti em breve;

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ βραδύνω, ἵνα εἰδῇς πῶς δεῖ ἐν οἴκῳ Θεοῦ ἀναστρέφεσθαι, ἥτις ἐστὶν ἐκκλησία Θεοῦ ζῶντος, στῦλος καὶ ἑδραίωμα τῆς ἀληθείας.

controles.web: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
controles.kjv: But if I tarry long, that thou mayest know how thou oughtest to behave thyself in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.
controles.livre: mas, seu eu demorar, para que saibais como se deve comportar  na casa de Deus, que é a igreja do Deus vivo, a coluna e o alicerce da verdade.

versos.grego: καὶ ὁμολογουμένως μέγα ἐστὶν τὸ τῆς εὐσεβείας μυστήριον· Ὃς ἐφανερώθη ἐν σαρκί, ἐδικαιώθη ἐν πνεύματι, ὤφθη ἀγγέλοις, ἐκηρύχθη ἐν ἔθνεσιν, ἐπιστεύθη ἐν κόσμῳ, ἀνελήμφθη ἐν δόξῃ.

controles.web: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great:  God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.
controles.kjv: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
controles.livre: E, sem dúvida nenhuma, grande é o mistério da devoção divina: Ele  foi revelado em carne, justificado em Espírito, visto pelos anjos, pregado aos gentios, crido no mundo, e recebido acima em glória.
